name: Love Love Chau!!
source:
Play as the handsome young man Hannibal Chau and embark on a story of love, mystery, and intrigue…

Make friends or make enemies.  Learn all about their interesting pasts and explore a world like no other.  A world that is the Shatterdome.

[From [url=http://detectivedeathmachine.tumblr.com/post/58510912830/love-love-chau]official site[/url]]
translation:
扮演英俊的年轻人汉尼拔·周，踏上一段交织着爱情、谜团与阴谋的旅程…

结交朋友，或是树立敌人。了解他们各自耐人寻味的过往，探索一个独一无二的世界——破碎穹顶。
